volatility.label: Volatility-triggered (5 business days)
volatility.trigger: NBA R09 (v1.1 narrowing): trigger severity ≥70 in the account's ISO; stage KYC_APPROVED, FUNDED or FIRST_TRADE (QUALIFIED only if exposure_score ≥90); exposure_score ≥80; no triggered sequence in 14d and no touch in 3d; p_active <0.95. Trigger types: hub price >3σ above its 30-day mean, scarcity/emergency alert, or forecast peak ≤72h out.
volatility.clock: business_days; offset_hours = hours after anchor (business days counted as 24h)

touches.purpose: Event email (send ≤4h): their hub chart, peak $/MWh and spike hours, illustrative replay of what a daily peak contract would have done; compliance-approved template + footer
Short personal note from the AE referencing the event at their hub; no pricing claims
Call + voicemail: ask how the event hit their book (short load, merchant output, missed spread) and what their hedge window is
Marketing's auto-generated event recap + forward look (5-day forecast peak at their hub, regime label)
Call: offer to size an illustrative position against their stated MW for the next forecast peak
Offer a 20-min walkthrough before the next forecast peak (calendar link); last touch of the sequence

rules: Max 1 triggered sequence per account per 14 calendar days, and one per account per ISO event (event_id), even when several hubs trigger.
SIGNED accounts stay on their KYC rule (R03/R04); the event may be used as the subject line of the KYC chase, compliance-approved.
Active / Expanding / At-Risk accounts get a single market note (NBA R15), never this sequence.
Eligible commercial/institutional accounts only; liquidity-partner accounts get a quoting note from Strategic Sales instead.
Every email passes the compliance linter and moves pending_review → approved → queued; nothing sends from pending_review.
Drafts use only computed facts (hub, peak, hours, timestamp, forecast); the copilot never invents prices or sizing.
Lead with forward risk (next forecast peak) as much as the realized spike, to avoid 'insurance after the fire'.
No promissory or advisory language; sizing is labeled illustrative; required disclaimer footer on every email.
Pauses the standard activation sequence for its duration; activation resumes at the next unsent touch.
Stops immediately on reply; the reply creates an AE task with 4h SLA.
exit_criteria: Compliance rejects the T0 draft (sequence cancelled, logged)
Day-5 touch sent with no response → account returns to its stage NBA rule

activation.label: Standard activation (8 touches over 21 days)
activation.trigger: Account enters FUNDED (deposit cleared); escalation path ties to NBA R06 (day 7) and R07 (day 21).

touches.purpose: Welcome + first-trade checklist (automated): login, order ticket tour, collateral balance, contract-spec page for their hub
Call: confirm authorized traders, risk limits and the first exposure they want to cover; book the walkthrough
Segment explainer video (e.g., REP peak-load hedging, storage spread capture, IPP shape risk)
Call: walk a sample order ticket at their hub; for PROP/FUND confirm API key and sandbox status
Invite to live walkthrough: replay of last 7 days at their hub with an illustrative DAILY_PEAK hedge (NBA R06)
Same-segment case study (anonymized, synthetic-labeled in demo) showing a routine, not a P&L claim
AE call + short note from Head of GTM offering an exec-level conversation on blockers
Escalate per NBA R07: Head of GTM diagnostic call; reason code logged

rules: One activation sequence per account; restarts only if the account re-funds after a full withdrawal.
Paused while a volatility sequence runs; resumes at the next unsent touch.
Skip the D10 case study if a walkthrough is already booked or held.
PROP/FUND: D1 call is co-owned by Solutions Eng when no API key exists (NBA R08).
Every logged touch writes an activities row (sequence='activation') within 24h.
Customer-facing emails pass the compliance linter before send.
exit_criteria: First qualifying trade (hand off to NBA R10 watch for a second trading day)
Account reaches Active (≥4 distinct trading days in trailing 30)
D21 escalation completed (hand off to Head of GTM, R07)

qbr.label: Institutional QBR (top-20 by ADV, every 90 days)
qbr.trigger: NBA R13 TOP20_QBR_DUE: top-20 account by 20-td ADV (LP volume reported separately) with no QBR in 90 days.

touches.purpose: RevOps builds the Account 360 pack: ADV trend, tenor/ISO utilization, spreads at their hubs, health and churn signals
Invite + agenda: their usage review, market structure update, roadmap preview, their asks
Prep: Head of GTM reviews 2 growth plays (2nd ISO, hourly tenor, API) and any open service issues
QBR meeting with trading + risk leads; Head of GTM attends for top-5 accounts
Recap with agreed actions, owners and dates; roadmap asks logged to Funnel & Journey
30-day follow-up on the growth plays agreed in the QBR

rules: Every top-20 account has a QBR on the calendar at all times; a missed 90-day cycle is an SLA breach on the scorecard.
Product roadmap previews are directional only; no commitments on dates or features in customer writing.
Liquidity-partner accounts get a separate liquidity-program review (quoting obligations, uptime), not this QBR.
exit_criteria: Recap sent and growth-play tasks created
Account drops out of top-20 for 2 consecutive months (moves to AE coverage)

win_back.label: Dormant win-back (weekly, event-tied)
win_back.trigger: NBA R14 DORMANT_30D: funded, zero trades in trailing 30 days, funded ≥30 days.

touches.purpose: What changed: spread/uptime trend at their hub, new hubs or tenors listed since they last traded (facts only)
Forward-risk note when a forecast peak at their hub is ≤5 days out (skip and re-check weekly if none)
AE note asking what stopped them trading (limits, policy, liquidity, people change)
AE call: log the dormancy reason code; offer a refresher walkthrough
Walkthrough offer timed to the next forecast event at their hub

rules: Max 1 touch per week; an event-tied note replaces (does not add to) the scheduled touch that week.
After day 28 with no response: monthly market digest only, re-enter on any forecast event at their hub.
All emails pass the compliance linter; no performance or savings claims.
exit_criteria: Any trade (account re-enters FIRST_TRADE / At-Risk path)
Reply or meeting booked (AE task, 24h SLA)
Collateral withdrawn and account closed, or opt-out
